subject.title: Add Codex fork-family provenance and missing-parent dedupe (#2037)

question: After the cache blockers and proof gap are resolved, should this combined PR replace the overlapping draft containment PR?
rationale: This branch includes the draft PR's containment commit plus a second substantial provenance policy, and the contributor explicitly asks maintainers to choose the landing structure.

options.title: Adopt combined PR
options.body: Use this branch as the single candidate and retire the overlapping draft after correctness, proof, and checks pass.

options.title: Split provenance commit
options.body: Resolve containment independently, then rebase only the missing-parent provenance change onto the selected mainline implementation.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while maintainers choose a different permanent accounting architecture.

recommendation.title: Adopt combined PR
recommendation.body: Use this branch as the single candidate and retire the overlapping draft after correctness, proof, and checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership of the scanner architecture and repository-level authority make this the best available owner for the combined-versus-split landing decision.
